But since Stock Up is already on the stack, the Brainstorm cards put back will be seen by Stock Up anyway, making the shuffle less necessary. The play is defensible but slightly questionable - they might want to hold Brainstorm for opponent's end step or to respond to interaction, and the Stock Up will already provide card selection. But with Emrakul in hand and Sneak Attack on board, the correct play is almost certainly to activate Sneak Attack immediately with Emrakul - annihilator 6 on a board where opponent has 6 permanents is game-ending.
